entities.summary: Caucasus Krai was an administrative division of the Russian Empire. It was established in 1844. From that time until 1882 the head of the region (krai) was Viceroy-namestnik, during 1882–1905 chief executive or commander-in-chief, and in 1905–1917 again namestnik.
